references.text: Moses and Eleazar the priest received the plunder and brought it into the tent of meeting as a reminder for the Israelites.
The Israelites camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho, the same place mentioned here.
Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke to the people on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
Describes the campsite on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
Commands and laws given on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
Jericho is mentioned as the city of palms in connection with the Jordan area and the land of Moab.
War spoils and captives were brought back to the camp and shared with the brothers, a similar situation.
